description: Baseline eval fixture for PP-003: how long it takes this reference app to prove itself from a torn-down, clean-environment starting state, and what evidence backs each R0-R3 control. Future changes to the app, the pack contracts, or the golden stack should be compared against this baseline, not just re-run ad hoc.

cleanEnvironmentRehearsal.scope: docker compose down -v, fresh Postgres, migrate, seed, docker build --no-cache, run, health check, smoke test, teardown

migrationRollbackRehearsal.scope: verify schema, apply rollback.sql, verify dropped, migrate deploy + seed, verify restored

readinessCheck.result: FAIL (23/25 controls) — the only two open items are version-control (working tree not yet committed) and ci (workflow file exists but no run has executed on a real remote yet); every other R0-R3 control has real, checked evidence
